{{Top|leg}}
'''Falleen Lady''' was a [[Casino/Legends|casino]] and pleasure house on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], owned by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Kurka]]. Known for its [[Pheromone/Legends|pheromone]]-enhanced hostesses, the casino ferried in customers through [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttles]], preventing larger [[Starship/Legends|starships]] from coming within weapons range.<ref name="Scum and Villainy">[[Scum and Villainy (sourcebook)|''Scum and Villainy'']]</ref>

Able to house thousands of [[Sentience/Legends|sentients]], it included luxury rooms for the rich guests, living quarters for the staff and barracks for the security. Since the security didn't allow the guests to bear weapons, it was also a popular meeting place.<ref name="Scum and Villainy" />
